description_en: Rebinds a phone number or merchant account ID to a flow
description_zh: 流程重新绑定号码或商家账号ID
name: FlowRebindPhone

parameters.help_en: The flow code. You can view it on the [Flow Builder](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page
parameters.help_zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看
parameters.name: flow_code

parameters.help_en: The message channel code, which is the channel ID. You can view the channel ID on the [Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page
parameters.help_zh: 消息渠道Code，即为通道ID，在[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看通道ID
parameters.name: channel_code

parameters.help_en:
The message channel type. Valid values:

- INSTAGRAM

- WHATSAPP

- MESSENGER

<props="intl">- VIBER</props>
parameters.help_zh:
消息渠道Type。取值：

- INSTAGRAM

- WHATSAPP

- MESSENGER

<props="intl">- VIBER</props>
parameters.name: channel_type

parameters.help_en: The list of phone numbers, PageIds, or AccountIds<props="intl">, or ServiceIds</props> under the channel instance
parameters.name: phone_numbers

parameters.help_en:
The WABA account ID, PageId, or AccountId<props="intl">, or ServiceId</props>.

- If ChannelType is set to WHATSAPP, specify the WABA account ID. You can view the WABA account ID on the Channel Management > Manage > WABA Management page.

- If ChannelType is not set to WHATSAPP, specify the PageId for MESSENGER, the AccountId for INSTAGRAM<props="intl">, or the ServiceId for VIBER</props>
parameters.help_zh:
WABA账号ID/PageId/AccountId<props="intl">/ServiceId</props>。

- 当ChannelType参数为WHATSAPP时，传WABA账号ID。在通道管理>管理>WABA管理界面查看WABA账号ID。

- 当ChannelType参数非WHATSAPP时，MESSENGER对应传PageId；INSTAGRAM对应传AccountId<props="intl">；VIBER对应传ServiceId</props>
parameters.name: waba_id

parameters.help_en: The flow version. On the [Flow Builder](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page, click the flow name to open the flow builder canvas and view the flow version
parameters.help_zh: 流程版本。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入流程编辑器画布界面查看流程版本
parameters.name: flow_version
